title: Generate all binary strings
problemStatement: Solve “Generate all binary strings” as posed in the A2Z sheet (Subsequences Pattern).
intuition: "Generate all binary strings" needs careful pointer rewiring. Draw before/after. Prefer O(1) aux when possible; never lose the next reference before rewiring.

approaches.title: Hash / multi-pass when helpful
approaches.idea: Store nodes or lengths when it simplifies correctness, then optimize.

approaches.title: Optimal pointer technique
approaches.idea: Fast/slow, dummy head, or in-place reverse — adapt to the problem.

commonMistakes: Forgetting dummy head for head-deletion cases
patternRecognition: Intersection → length align or switch pointers
interviewInsight: For "Generate all binary strings", interviewers watch pointer hygiene more than clever tricks.
